dataset.title: NASA F-117 model: azimuth response, figures 5.10–5.12
dataset.data_method: Approximate values extracted from the printed figures (extract/digitize.py). No raw numeric data was found.

limits: The magnitude reference is not stated, so the curves are not absolute RCS.
The curves cover azimuth 175° to 185° only, with gaps where the line was not read.
They describe one aluminum model in one test record, not a service aircraft.

Do not convert these values to dBsm or m², and do not use them for absolute power or range.
